parent.scope: Strict incremental UTF-8 decoder over feed/finish/reset events. Tracks incomplete multi-byte prefixes across feeds, validates continuation ranges and overlong/surrogate/out-of-range restrictions, counts complete code points only from successful calls, and treats any malformed chunk or unfinished prefix at finish as an error contributing zero for that call.
parent.change: Implemented investigate with a byte-level UTF-8 validator that returns the valid complete code-point count and whether the buffer is complete; feeds add valid complete code points, retain a legal incomplete suffix, or set error; finish succeeds only with an empty buffer; reset restores count=0 and status=open.
